issue_request: FHIR-9853 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request, raised against DSTU2 and applied for R5, asking to allow the standard _list search parameter on Resource-level/server-root searches so [base]/?_list can return all resource types referenced by a List.
initial_application: A May 2021 Jira/Zulip note confirmed the approved change had not yet been applied. The Jira-tagged commit 0ad8347015dc36b2f56cb96aeaad8fee2352c541 then added Resource-_list to source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml and clarified source/search.html.
additional_context: Resource is active in the current build through source/fhir.ini. Later Published search issues kept and refined the behavior: FHIR-31387 handled the structured _list SearchParameter and summary row, FHIR-37846 retained _list while adding _in for broader membership searches, and FHIR-39342 linked the functional-list wording. FHIR-9816 is related background but was not needed to decide the seed.
reconciliation: No source changes were made. source/resource/bundle-Resource-search-params.xml already defines Resource-_list as a common special SearchParameter, and source/search.html documents _list with a GET [base]/?_list=101 example for any resource referenced by a List.
